label: Every originating cause operates through its own existentially productive exercise
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge: for every CAUSE_4 originating-cause edge CausesOrigin c x, an occurring exercise a borne by c produces x's existence, with produces in the same sense as DEF-NO-EXISTENTIAL-SELF-PRODUCTION (production of the being of the resultant individual, not merely of its coming-to-be). The passage from causing x's coming-to-be to producing x's being is part of this bridge's open content. This maps a source/target edge into the existing bearer/exercise/product vocabulary, without building causal priority or irreflexivity into CausesOrigin. It does not assert that anything originates, nor that every sort of cause is an originating cause. Attribution deferred; the application to reality is not established.
